situation (example wording): Any answer with a month, a year or a figure that is not there: "No data is available for March 2024: shown blank, not zero.", "No figure is available for March 2020 for Dallas, Texas: shown blank, not zero.", "Not every month of 2025 is available: shown blank, not zero.", "No clearance rate is given: no data is available for March 2026."
what the app does today: The same sentences said "is known" ("No data is known for ...", "No figure is known for ...", "... not every month is known").
proposed behavior: A month or figure that is missing is said to be not available, never not known: "No data is available for ...", "No figure is available for ...", "Not every month of ... is available", "because not every month is available". Pure wording; the figures and the rest of each sentence are unchanged. "Unknown" stays a category label.
